variables.documentation: Further configuration parameters

variables.name: particle_energy_ev
variables.documentation: particle energy in eV; <= 0 selects 3.5 MeV/facE_al

variables.name: netcdffile
variables.documentation: Empty = unset, apply 'wout.nc' default at usage

variables.name: ns_s
variables.documentation: <- spline order for R,Z,lambda over s

variables.name: ns_tp
variables.documentation: <- spline order for R,Z,lambda over theta and varphi

variables.name: canonical_chart
variables.documentation: Canonical chart of the symplectic guiding-centre step. 'polar' steps in (r, theta, phi, p_phi). 'cartesian' steps in the global Darboux chart X, Y = sqrt(2 |p_theta|) (cos theta, sigma sin theta), phi, p_phi, which is regular at the magnetic axis; it needs integmode 3-7 (midpoint, Gauss1-4) and a Boozer (VMEC or Boozer chartmap) or test field.

variables.name: orbit_coord
variables.documentation: Chart for the full-orbit field+geometry: full orbit currently supports only orbit_coord = 1 (Boozer/chartmap), which shares the production GC field.

variables.name: gpu_mode
variables.documentation: GPU execution is configured in the same namelist as the CPU run. Native CUDA with tuned DOPRI is the default production path. The legacy OpenACC path remains available only when selected explicitly.

variables.name: class_plot
variables.documentation: <=AAA

variables.name: cut_in_per
variables.documentation: <=AAA

variables.name: swcoll
variables.documentation: Colliding with D-T reactor plasma. TODO: Make configurable

variables.name: collision_model
variables.documentation: 'full' (Coulomb operator) or 'lorentz_nustar' (monoenergetic pitch scattering)

variables.name: nu_star_standard
variables.documentation: Lorentz mode: nu* = R0*nu/(abs(iota)*v0), must be >= 0

variables.name: lorentz_major_radius_cm
variables.documentation: Lorentz mode: local major radius R0 in cm, must be > 0

variables.name: lorentz_iota
variables.documentation: Lorentz mode: local rotational transform, must be nonzero

variables.name: radial_electric_potential_slope
variables.documentation: slope of Phi(s) = slope*s, added to the Boozer Hamiltonian H (normalized units)

variables.name: old_axis_healing
variables.documentation: DEPRECATED boolean switches (use axis_healing). Kept for back-compat and mapped to a mode with a deprecation warning; the next SIMPLE release will remove them and default axis_healing to 'polyfit'.

variables.name: rho_axis_heal
variables.documentation: deprecated; use s_axis_heal

variables.name: axis_healing
variables.documentation: Near-axis healing of the VMEC harmonics. Preferred selector: axis_healing = 'legacy'          - old default: discard min(|m|,4) surfaces and extrapolate. 'legacy_adaptive' - old adaptive boundary from determine_nheal_for_axis. 'powerlaw'        - rho**|m| continuation below s_axis_heal. 'polyfit'         - rho**|m| * least-squares poly(s) below s_axis_heal. Recommended. The empty string means "unset": deprecated logical switches below are mapped to a mode with a warning (see resolve_axis_healing_mode).

variables.name: s_axis_heal
variables.documentation: anchor flux for powerlaw/polyfit

variables.name: axis_healing_polyfit_degree
variables.documentation: polyfit polynomial degree in s

variables.name: batch_size
variables.documentation: Initialize large so batch mode is not default

variables.name: profile_label_file
variables.documentation: Optional netCDF profile label s(R, phi, Z) for the collision profiles with integ_coords = REFCOORDS (format: src/profile_label.f90).

variables.name: integ_coords
variables.documentation: Sentinel: -1000 means user did not set it

variables.name: crossing_level
variables.documentation: SPECTRE interface treatment: only full orbit (3) is supported.

variables.name: spectre_fo_entry_larmor
variables.documentation: Full orbit near SPECTRE interfaces: entry distance in radial gyroradii and the relative tolerance of RK45 on the sharp per-volume field. 1.5 keeps the switch's p_zeta invariant as at 3 (entry 1 breaks it) at about half the FO time (concept/spectre_loss_study/results/fo-residence).

variables.name: spectre_fo_grid
variables.documentation: Per-volume FO spline points: rho, theta, zeta per field period.

variables.name: spectre_ncon_r
variables.documentation: SPECTRE per-volume Meiss construction grid (n_r, n_th, n_phi). Each volume allocates rank-3 arrays plus batch splines of this size, so the total peak memory scales as Mvol*n_r*n_th*n_phi. spectre_ncon_phi = -1 means automatic: 32 for fields with toroidal harmonics and a minimal phi grid for axisymmetric fields (all n = 0), the dominant memory saver for tokamak cases. A positive value forces that phi count verbatim, bypassing the axisymmetric clamp.

variables.name: checkpoint_interval
variables.documentation: Legacy progress/checkpoint interval, retained for input compatibility. Tracing performs no timed I/O; results and event totals are emitted after the OpenMP team joins.

variables.name: local
variables.documentation: Removed &config keys. They are still read so that old input files run; a value other than the historical default prints a warning.
